name: Bitcoin Trade Live
prompt: "Build a live Bitcoin trade feed. Connect to wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/btcusdt@trade using os.network.socket. Each trade arrives as JSON — show a scrolling list of the last 20 trades with price, quantity, and a green (buy) or red (sell) color. Display connection status and reconnect automatically on close
lastChange: Edit the Bitcoin trade feed app — replace the Binance WebSocket URL with CoinCap's: wss://ws.coincap.io/prices?assets=bitcoin,ethereum. The message format from CoinCap is a JSON object like {"bitcoin"
